submitted.rationale: Photocurrent was measured at 3 compositions. V0.86Zr0.14 (#12) gave 5.98e-6 A, the highest. V0.88 (#10) gave 3.73e-6 A and V0.67 (#14, near ZrV2O7) gave 8.4e-7 A. The V-rich end, which is likely V2O5-like and absorbs at 3.22 eV, clearly outperforms. The best value lies inside the V-rich range rather than at its edge.

rejected.reason: Measured 8.4e-7 A; the ZrV2O7-like region is weak
Photocurrent fell steeply as Zr increased, and ZrO2 is too wide-gap to absorb 3.22 eV light
